thread:
Anya: Heads-up — Marlin Labs shows 4 enrolled seats in the preview but only 1 user activity last week. Flagging as potential churn/ghost-seats. Need a quick re-engage plan.
Mike: ack. Do we have the contact list and which seats are inactive?
Anya: I pulled the audit: seats 2/3/4 haven't sent any requests, onboarding emails opened but no follow-ups. Primary contact is @mike (buyer) and secondary is lucy@marlin (engineering).
Jess: I can run a 2-question micro-survey to the enrolled list. Suggested Qs: 1) what's blocking you from trying Redwood? 2) would a 30m walkthrough help? :clipboard:
Ravi: +1 to survey. Also propose a targeted enablement session this Thurs 10am PT (30m) focusing on quick wins (sample prompts, embedding use-case). We can offer a sandbox share.
Anya: Sounds good. Risk level: medium-high — Marlin's contract renewal is 6 weeks after preview ends. If we don't see usage uptick we'll lose upsell runway.
Mike: I'll reach out to the buyer (Mike B.) this afternoon with a soft nudge and offer the walkthrough. Can you drop me the one-click calendar copy?
Jess: Draft message for outreach (feel free to copy/edit):
```
Hi Mike — quick check-in: noticed a few of your team haven't had a chance to try the preview. We can run a short 30m session to demo a couple of flows that deliver immediate value (code snippets + templates). If that helps, pick a time here: <cal.link/marlin-30m>
```
Ravi: Also adding an enablement agenda: 1) quick goals + metrics, 2) live demo (10m), 3) hands-on exercise (15m), 4) next steps + success criteria (5m). Please capture outcomes in the account playbook.
Anya: Assigning actions: Mike — buyer outreach (today). Jess — micro-survey to enrolled list (tomorrow). Ravi — prepare enablement deck + sandbox creds (tomorrow EOD). I'll update CSM notes and tag renewal risk if no usage change in 10 days.
Mike: Done — I'll ping after outreach.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Marlin Labs - Preview Enablement" Thu 10:00-10:30 PT — invite sent to marlin@domain.com.
Jess: Survey sent (subject: Quick check on Redwood preview) — included optional time slots for the 30m session and a one-click calendar link.
Anya: Quick template for internal tracking (please paste into playbook):
```
Outcome: (attended / no-show / declined)
Active users after session: (n)
Key blockers raised: (list)
Success criteria agreed: (list)
Follow-up owner + due date:
```
Ravi: I'll prep the deck with a 5-slide 'value map' that ties features to Marlin's stated goals. Sharing draft link in #engage-assets in 3 hours.
Mike: Buyer replied — prefers Wed 2pm. Can we move?
Ravi: I can do Wed 2pm, updating deck timeline.
Anya: Great — changing invite to Wed 2pm, will mark as high-priority outreach in Gainsight notes.
Jess: Will follow up with a short reminder email 24h before. :bell:
Anya: If after the session we don't see >2 active users in the following week, plan B is a 1:1 engineering pairing to ship an integration snippet. Tagging for escalation.
Mike: Agreed. I'll capture action items after the meeting and update thread.
Anya: Thanks team — keeping this tight. :thumbsup:
